description: Build BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema from your page's breadcrumb trail.

faqs.a: Add each crumb with its label and URL, in order from home to the current page. The tool numbers positions automatically.
faqs.q: How do I build the trail?

faqs.a: Positions start at 1 for the home page and increment — the generator handles this.
The last crumb is the current page — it still gets a position and URL in the list.
faqs.q: Should the current page be included?

faqs.a: Copy the JSON-LD into your page <head> and validate with Google's Rich Results Test.
faqs.q: How do I use the output?

howto: Enter each breadcrumb label and its URL, from home onward.
Click Add Crumb for each level.
Reorder by removing and re-adding if needed.
Generate, copy and paste the JSON-LD into your page.
title: Breadcrumb Schema Generator
